summary: Review A (correctness and architecture) passes Phase 1 of primary_class_session_lifetime_20261111 at 9e2bc749258cb6bc1b1fd666c104e932bb978564. HEAD is daaee360d. The commits after 9e2bc7492 change only apps/storytime and measure files, so the audited track files are the same at HEAD. The pure function computeSessionExpiry gives the right value for each choice and uses no server time zone. The refusal runs before ensureStudentCredentials and before the old session closes. Only one caller of startClassSession exists and it still compiles. Only one Record over StudentLoginErrorCode exists and it holds invalid_input. The panel, the strings, and the tests match the spec. I found no blocking defect and five nonblocking findings (F121 to F125).
nonblocking_findings: F121 (panel state, minor): ClassSessionControl keeps the state value 'until_17' after the option is hidden. The clock can pass 17:00 while the page stays open, and the roster refresh then renders the radio group with no checked radio. Start still posts 'until_17'. The server refuses it and the panel shows the lifetimeInvalid text, so the teacher can recover. Advice: derive the effective choice, for example choices.includes(lifetime) ? lifetime : '3h' (class-session-control.tsx:96-98 and :69). OQ-2 accepts the server refusal, so this is not blocking.

F122 (JSDoc, minor): The export classSessionLifetime at contracts.ts:37 carries the old comment 'Request from a teacher to start a class login session.' That text describes classSessionStartInput. It does not describe the enum. Change it to a text such as 'The three lifetime choices of a class sign-in session.' (AGENTS.md JSDoc rule).

F123 (format, nit): class-session.ts:169 holds two statements on one line with trailing spaces: 'let row: { id: string } | undefined;    try {'. The edit that removed the 'const expiresAt' line caused it. ESLint exits 0, but the line breaks the code style of the file. Put 'try {' on its own line.

F124 (text and code clarity, nit): The help text lifetimeHelp7d says 'until this time', but the panel shows no time next to the 7-day choice before the start. The key stays in the strings list for the Thai check, so the text decision belongs to Review C and the PM. Also, startClassSession (class-session.ts:127) and computeSessionExpiry (:46) both turn undefined into '3h'. One of the two defaults is enough.

F125 (test gap, minor): No panel test posts 'until_17' (the posted-body cases cover '3h' and '7d' only), and no test covers the hidden-but-selected state of F121. A mutant that posts a wrong value for 'until_17' would pass the panel tests. The domain, the contract, and the handler tests cover 'until_17' fully.
evidence: Check 1 (expiry values): class-session.ts:46-67 is a switch. '3h' returns now + CLASS_SESSION_LIFETIME_MS (3 h, same value as before). '7d' returns now + 7 d. 'until_17' reads the Bangkok date with calendarDayKey(now, SCHOOL_TIME_ZONE) (calendar-day.ts:19-27) and adds 10 h to Bangkok midnight UTC, which is 17:00 Bangkok (10:00Z). It throws invalid_input when now >= that instant, so 17:00:00 and later are refused and 09:59:59Z works. undefined gives '3h'. null and unknown values (including 'constructor', '__proto__') reach default and throw. The function has no getHours, no toLocale*, and no new Date(y,m,d), so it has no dependence on the server time zone. Test rows: student-login-class-session.test.ts lines 'computes the expiry for %s', 'works at the last second', 'refuses until_17 at %s', 'uses the Bangkok date when the UTC date still shows the day before'.

Check 1 TZ matrix (my run): TZ=America/Los_Angeles, domain class-session file exit 0, tests_total=53, tests_failed=0. TZ=America/Los_Angeles, app control file exit 0, tests_total=32, tests_failed=0. The Green log records the same counts for Asia/Bangkok and UTC (tz_runs_green=3).

Check 2 (F1 order): startClassSession calls authorizeClassroom (read), then computeSessionExpiry (class-session.ts:126-128), then ensureStudentCredentials (:129). No insert, update, or audit call comes before the check. Tests 'refuses until_17 at %s before it writes any row' and 'refuses an unknown value before it writes any row' use writingDb (a credential-less student and an open old session). The control test 'the writing fixture writes the credential, the old close, and the session' asserts insert=2, update=2, and audit=2, so the fixture can write (A4 positive control). The refusal tests assert no insert, no update, no delete, and no audit call. I did not run a mutant (audit-only role). The control proves the fixture, so a check placed after ensureStudentCredentials would leave one insert and fail.

Check 3 (callers): grep over apps and packages (without dist, node_modules, .next) lists one production caller of startClassSession and classSessionStartInput: apps/primary-advantage/lib/student-login/handlers.ts:6-7. It passes the parsed contract output, which is assignable to the z.input type. The real-db and mock tests pass { classroomId } only and still compile (the Green log records domain and app check-types exit 0 with typecheck_errors_in_existing_tests=0). No other file reads ClassSessionStartInput. The handler adds no logic and stays thin.

Check 4 (error code): grep for StudentLoginErrorCode finds one Record: STATUS in http.ts:11, and it holds invalid_input: 400 (http.ts:14). Other uses are the type itself and the error class constructor (errors.ts:27). Client code (code-sign-in.tsx:73 and the class-login api.ts errorKey) maps by status and by code with if statements, not by a switch, so nothing falls through. api.ts maps only a 400 with code invalid_input to lifetimeInvalid, and a contract 400 stays generic (tests 'maps the invalid_input code to the lifetime error key' and 'shows the generic error for a contract 400 with no code').

Check 5 (panel): class-session-control.tsx:73 state default '3h'. The radiogroup (:117-131) holds a visible label for each option with class min-h-11 (44 px). The until_17 option is filtered by minutesOfDay(new Date()) < 17*60 with Intl and SCHOOL_TIME_ZONE (:96-98). The start and New code bodies are { classroomId, lifetime } (:69, test asserts the two keys). The D-6 text uses calendarDayNumber for the Bangkok day and adds month and day for a later date; useIntlFormatter uses SCHOOL_TIME_ZONE (intl-locale.ts:39). Tests assert en 'Nov 18, 12:00 PM' and th '18 พ.ย. 12:00'. Strings: the git diff shows the six keys in en and th with the planned text, and cn, tw, vi hold the English text (decision F5); test 'holds every new key in all five locales' checks keys_checked=30. The 44 px proof is a class check (an artifact test), which the strategy names. The browser check is outside this role.

Check 6 (test meaning): My run of the Green command at HEAD. Domain four files: exit 0, tests_total=108, passed=96, skipped=12 (real-db skipped without PG_TEST_URL), failed=0. App three files: exit 0, tests_total=82, passed=82, failed=0. All nine student-login domain files: exit 0, tests_total=168, passed=156, skipped=12, failed=0. These counts match the plan notes of tasks 1.5, 1.7, 1.11 (A5 check passed: no claim without a matching run). The Red log records 43 domain and 29 app failures at the base for the stated reasons and red_failures_bad_reason=0. The tests call the real domain function, the real contract, the real handler, and the real component. The mock database is used only for write counts, which the strategy allows. The real-db case (student-login.real-db.test.ts, new it) reads the row, asserts expiresAt - startsAt equals 604800000 ms, asserts findOpenSession and signInWithCardToken work at expiresAt - 1 ms and fail at expiresAt, then the restart and the early end. I did not rerun it (it needs a scratch Postgres under heavy-run). The Green log records real_db_ran=1, tests_total=12, tests_failed=0 at 78df5d21d, and no track file changed between 78df5d21d and 9e2bc7492 except measure files (git diff --stat).

Check 7 (JSDoc): every new or changed export has a comment without types: ClassSessionLifetime, classSessionStartInput, ClassSessionStartInput, StudentLoginErrorCode, startClassSession (@throws updated), errorKey, ClassLoginErrorKey; the private computeSessionExpiry also has full JSDoc. Defect: the comment of classSessionLifetime is wrong (F122).

Check 8 (scope): git diff --name-only db8672b04..9e2bc7492 for packages/db, card-token.ts, picture-password.ts, rate-limits.ts, codes.ts, credentials.ts returns an empty list. Non-measure, non-storytime changed files are only the Red and Green paths and the five message files; no other app changed. Added lines with sha256, createHash, or checksum outside measure, storytime, and docs: 0.

Plan claims check (A3, A4, A5): the plan counts are labeled integers (tz_runs_green=3, keys_checked=30, real_db_tests_total=12). The new counting loops in the tests assert their input size first (choices toHaveLength(3), refusedBodies toHaveLength(6), LIFETIME_MESSAGE_KEYS toHaveLength(6), locales toHaveLength(5)). No test passes on a missing deliverable: the key-parity case uses a safe reader that fails on a missing path with typeof 'string'. I did not rerun the domain aggregate suite (suite_tests=2271) or the type checks; I read those claims from the Green log. They are heavy commands and not a correctness claim of this audit.

HEAD note: git rev-parse HEAD is daaee360d, not 9e2bc7492. The brief names 9e2bc7492 as the audited head and marks later Storytime commits out of scope. git diff --name-only 9e2bc7492..HEAD lists only apps/storytime and measure files, so no lifetime file differs between the two commits.
Review B finding F101 (OQ-1, PM decision) is not repeated here; I agree that no refusal rule is a correctness defect.
